name: ncCAM
author: ncSender
description: Turns a 3D part (STEP, STL or 3MF) into G-code: finds the pockets, holes, steps, threads, chamfers and outline, picks end mills, drills, thread mills and V-bits from your Tool Library, and sets speeds and feeds for the material. 2.5D parts cut from the top; curved 3D parts get roughing and ball-end finishing. Resize the part, preview the cut as material is removed, then load it into ncSender or save it to File Manager.
